faq.a: Shipping cost automation is when an AI checks shipping rates for a customer automatically instead of an admin looking them up by hand. In Cekat.AI, the AI agent checks the ongkir through API integration during the chat and quotes an accurate cost in seconds, then folds it into the order.

faq.q: How does Cekat.AI check the shipping cost?
faq.a: Through API integration. When a customer asks about shipping, the AI reads the destination from the conversation, checks the rate via the connected shipping API, and quotes the accurate cost right in the chat, no admin, no manual lookup, no delay while the buyer waits.

Yes. Because the rate comes through API integration rather than a manual estimate, the customer sees the real shipping cost. That accuracy matters, a wrong quote either eats your margin or surprises the buyer at payment and loses the sale entirely.

faq.q: How fast do customers get the ongkir?
faq.a: In seconds. The AI checks and quotes the shipping cost the moment the customer asks, inside the same conversation. There's no queue behind other chats and no waiting for an admin to be free, which is exactly what keeps a ready buyer from abandoning the order.

faq.q: Does automatic shipping check reduce abandoned orders?
faq.a: It helps. Many orders are lost in the silence after "how much is shipping?" When the ongkir appears instantly and accurately in the same chat, buyers keep going instead of leaving for a faster seller, and the AI moves straight on to collecting payment.

faq.q: What channels does the shipping check work on?
faq.a: All of them. WhatsApp via the official Business API, Instagram DM, Facebook Messenger, website live chat, and API channels, every conversation lands in one unified inbox and the AI can check and quote shipping on whichever channel the customer used.

faq.q: Does the shipping cost get added to the order automatically?
faq.a: Yes. After checking the ongkir, the AI adds it to the order total and continues the flow, collecting customer details and sending a payment QR in the same chat. The shipping quote is one automatic step toward a completed, paid order.

faq.q: Does it work outside business hours?
faq.a: Yes. The AI quotes shipping 24/7. With AI working hours, your team handles chats during office hours and the AI takes over after, so a customer asking about ongkir at night gets an instant answer instead of waiting until your team is back online.

faq.q: Do I need to code the shipping integration myself?
faq.a: No coding is required on your side. Cekat.AI handles shipping through API integration, and you set up the AI by pasting your business info into the knowledge base and shaping conversations with a visual drag-and-drop flow designer, building an agent takes around five minutes.
